title: Institution scoping and data isolation
workflow: Authenticate subject and validate token issuer/audience
Resolve licensed institution from a trusted server-side context
Bind actor role, branch and purpose to one policy decision
Verify resource ownership and action entitlement before query/write
Apply institution filter in data access and event publication
Record denied access and alert on anomalous cross-scope attempts
requirements: Never trust client-supplied institution ID without server-side membership proof
Enforce authorization on individual objects and nested relationship references
Make role policies versioned, maker-checker controlled and independently auditable
Separate encryption keys, secrets, settlement credentials and production identities by approved trust scope
Prohibit default fallbacks from one institution's policy or accounts into another's workflow
Support explicit supervisory access only under recorded legal authority and least privilege
acceptance_cases: Cross-tenant customer ID fetch returns denied without data leakage
Cross-tenant mutation is rejected even for an authorized user of another institution
Token from wrong audience or revoked role cannot access records
Event consumer ignores payload with mismatched institution scope
Admin cannot approve their own institution-level privilege escalation
approval_gate: Institution profile, legal privacy review, IAM design approval and executable isolation test evidence.
